title: README states 14 vitest tests; actual suite is 26
symptom: README quickstart says `python scripts/verify.py --e2e` runs '14 vitest tests'; `npm run unit` on a fresh clone runs 26.
reproduce: cd rescue-scanner && npm ci && npm run unit  # Test Files 4 passed, Tests 26 passed; README.md line ~32 says 14
expected: README count matches the suite, or the line names no count at all.
regression_test: manual: README no longer carries a hard-coded test count
root_cause: Hard-coded suite size written before later tests landed; count went stale. Fixed by removing the static number per the no-stale-number proof rule.
bench_note: one-line doc fix; no behavioural gate
notes: Found during Review A fresh-clone audit. Prefer removing the static count over updating it, per the no-stale-number proof rule.
